routines.semantics: Append complete time-tagged Chebyshev records to the actual open stream. References have variable spacings and must be strictly increasing within and across calls; the six polynomials independently encode Cartesian position and velocity.

scenarios.observes: Stream independently supplied position and velocity coefficients in two additions with unequal time radii. Check the transition, endpoints, descriptor and all six outputs.
The same packets written in one physical addition give all six expected components on either side of their knot.
Constant position and independently constant velocity are retained, including a discontinuity at the exact new packet start.
Nonzero second-order coefficients are evaluated in all six components at midpoint, boundaries and two interior offsets.
Multiple additions cross the 100-reference directory boundary. Inspect exact knots and interpolated states on both sides.

A complete type 10 writer opens and closes its own generic segment between two type 14 packet additions. Reopen both files, inspect both descriptors and compare the independent physical states.

routines.edgeAssessment: Complete physical data include midpoint, radius, six coefficient groups and a separate epoch per record. One, multiple and 102 records cover exact knots, edge selection and directory indexing. Cross-file type 10 completion between additions preserves selection and state. Degree/count/word guards retain addressable sentinel data for genuine zero-count diagnostics.

routines.semantics: Finish a type 14 generic segment. The metadata and reference directory become readable after file close. The same file handle can immediately start another segment; ending an empty stream yields legitimate metadata-only coverage.

scenarios.observes: Finish, then begin a second segment on the same writer with different degree and record stride. Later coverage takes precedence.
Ending an empty stream writes genuine generic metadata. Observe the object, descriptor and coverage without evaluating absent packets.
A repeated end after completing a valid segment reaches the real no-active-writer error.
An end on a newly opened writer with no generic stream raises CALLEDOUTOFORDER.
Ending commits all variable-interval Chebyshev records with distinct six-component coefficients, including an exact boundary jump.
CSPICE stores a negative time radius as supplied; reversed normalized polynomial arguments produce the expected signed slope.

routines.edgeAssessment: Checks repeated end, end without begin, zero-packet metadata, overlapping replacement segment and 22 interrupted native writer disposals. Cross-client and two-active-file isolation and interleaved physical output are externally read back.
